acceptance_criteria: Round-trip encode test: encode a multi-cell, lattice-bearing Geometry and assert the decoded buffers reproduce every surface, cell RPN, and lattice entry; layout documented in module doc.
description: Flatten a Geometry (surfaces SoA, cells' boolean RPN region tokens, universe nesting, lattice tables) into a stable GPU-friendly layout (structs-of-arrays, index handles not pointers) in src/gpu/. Foundation shared by the region-eval, distance, and lattice-descent kernels; defines the encoding the WGSL side decodes.
title: outram-mc GPU: host-side Geometry -> GPU buffer serialization

description: teh-o-prke currently has 'openfoam-basic-lib.workspace = true' (Cargo.toml:22) and uses its LDU/matrix solvers in src/zero_power_prke/six_group_precursor_prke/implicit_solver.rs. Inline the specific matrix-solver code it needs (openfoam-basic-lib::ldu_matrix / matrix) directly into teh-o-prke and remove the openfoam-basic-lib path dep. Rationale: keep the inter-crate dependency graph acyclic so teh-o-prke and tuas can both be composed by a future full 'tampines' (multiphase-flow) crate and by nee_soon without risking dependency loops. This is a DELIBERATE duplication that overrides the usual 'openfoam-basic-lib is the shared math-building-block layer' principle for these two consumer crates -- decoupling is preferred over DRY here (user decision 2026-07-08).

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content: Also aids Android portability (op-zfr): dropping openfoam-basic-lib removes any transitive BLAS/ndarray-linalg exposure from teh-o-prke.

title: Inline matrix solvers into teh-o-prke; drop openfoam-basic-lib dependency
